mentions.note: Physiology was not taught at school, but reading the woodblock-printed Quanti Xinlun and Huaxue Weisheng Lun, we learned ever more clearly that Chinese medicine was nothing but conscious or unconscious deception.*

mentions.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
mentions.note: Cassell & Co. write proposing to publish The Bottle Imp together with The Beach of Falesa as 'Island Nights' Entertainments'. The two are too different in flavour; is that not odd?*

mentions.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
mentions.note: The two are so different in flavour that it seems odd. Why not add The Isle of Voices and The Waif Woman?*

mentions.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
mentions.note: Why not add The Isle of Voices and The Waif Woman? ... Fanny, however, objects to including The Waif Woman.*
